Β 656). ἤπειρος; Κάβειρος, a city of Lower Asia. But Alexion writes the daimones Καβείρους with ι, and likewise Philoxenus. Tradition, however, has the diphthong, and perhaps it ran together with μάγειρος, αἴγειρος, πέπειρος, ὄνειρος. But the αι of the first syllable has come from ἀΐσσω by crasis. There is also Αἴγειρος, a city of the Megarid, as Theopompus says in the fifty-sixth book, which Strabo calls Αἰγείρουσα. σάπφειρος, a stone; Στάγειρος. Κύστιρος, Δύσιρος, Βεδύσιρος; ἄϊρος, a compound from the disyllable Ἶρος: “ἦ τάχα Ἶρος ἄϊρος”

"""Offline browser checks. Run with a candidate bundle and an output JSON argument."""
import html
import json
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys
import unicodedata

from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
from cloud_gadgets import digest
from generate_site import gadget_srcdoc


def encode(value):
    return value if isinstance(value, str) else json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)


def mount(page, candidate):
    src = html.escape(gadget_srcdoc(**candidate), quote=True)
    page.set_content('<!doctype html><html><head><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><style>body{margin:0}iframe{display:block;width:100%;height:2400px;border:0}</style></head><body><iframe sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" srcdoc="'+src+'"></iframe></body></html>')
    frame = page.frames[1]
    frame.wait_for_load_state('domcontentloaded')
    assert page.locator('iframe').get_attribute('sandbox') == 'allow-scripts allow-forms'
    return frame


def no_overflow(frame):
    return frame.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= document.documentElement.clientWidth')


def confinement(page, attempted):
    # Deliberately separate from the submitted candidates. All probes use a
    # reserved invalid host, and every browser request is intercepted/aborted.
    probe = {
        'html':'<button id="submit-probe" type="button">Test blocked form</button>',
        'css':'',
        'js':r'''
window.probe={directives:[],imageFailed:false,scriptFailed:false,fetchFailed:false};
document.addEventListener('securitypolicyviolation',e=>window.probe.directives.push(e.effectiveDirective));
const target='https://gadget-probe.invalid';
const img=new Image();img.onerror=()=>window.probe.imageFailed=true;img.src=target+'/image';document.body.appendChild(img);
const script=document.createElement('script');script.onerror=()=>window.probe.scriptFailed=true;script.src=target+'/script';document.body.appendChild(script);
fetch(target+'/connection').catch(()=>window.probe.fetchFailed=true);
document.getElementById('submit-probe').addEventListener('click',()=>{const form=document.createElement('form');form.action=target+'/form';form.method='POST';document.body.appendChild(form);form.submit();});
'''
    }
    frame = mount(page, probe)
    frame.locator('#submit-probe').click()
    frame.wait_for_function("window.probe.imageFailed && window.probe.scriptFailed && window.probe.fetchFailed && window.probe.directives.includes('form-action')")
    observed = frame.evaluate('window.probe')
    return {
        'image_blocked':observed['imageFailed'] and 'img-src' in observed['directives'],
        'script_blocked':observed['scriptFailed'] and 'script-src-elem' in observed['directives'],
        'connection_blocked':observed['fetchFailed'] and 'connect-src' in observed['directives'],
        'form_blocked':'form-action' in observed['directives'],
        'external_requests':len(attempted),
        'sandbox':'allow-scripts allow-forms'
    }


def run(bundle):
    results = {}
    with sync_playwright() as playwright:
        browser = playwright.chromium.launch(executable_path=shutil.which('chromium'), headless=True)
        for role in ('new','past'):
            candidate = bundle[role]['candidate']
            context = browser.new_context(viewport={'width':1200,'height':900}, service_workers='block')
            attempted, errors, assertions = [], [], []
            def abort(route):
                attempted.append('blocked request')
                route.abort()
            context.route('**/*',abort)
            page = context.new_page()
            page.on('pageerror',lambda error: errors.append(str(error)))
            frame = mount(page,candidate)
            def record(case, actual, expected):
                actual, expected = encode(actual), encode(expected)
                entry = dict(case=case,expected=expected,actual=actual,passed=actual==expected)
                assertions.append(entry)
                assert entry['passed'], json.dumps(entry,ensure_ascii=False)
            if role == 'new':
                def lookup(word):
                    frame.locator('#word').fill(word)
                    frame.locator('#inspect').click()
                    return [frame.locator('#form').inner_text(),frame.locator('#kind').inner_text()]
                record('Empty initial prompt',frame.locator('#status').inner_text(),'Choose an example or type a listed form.')
                record('Polysyllabic indeclinable retains acute',lookup('περικλυτος'),['περικλυτός','Retained final acute'])
                record('Monosyllabic indeclinable raises accent',lookup('προκλυτος'),['πρόκλυτος','Raised to the antepenult'])
                lookup('ναυσικλυτος')
                record('Dative compound exception is explicit',[frame.locator('#form').inner_text(),frame.locator('#kind').inner_text(),'dative ναυσί' in frame.locator('#reason').inner_text()],['ναυσικλυτός','Marked exception: final acute',True])
                record('Juxtaposed phrase stays two words',lookup('  δουρι   κλυτος  '),['δουρὶ κλυτός','Juxtaposition: two words'])
                record('φιλίατρος raises accent',lookup('φιλιατρος'),['φιλίατρος','Raised accent'])
                record('ἀρχιατρός preserves final acute',lookup('αρχιατρος'),['ἀρχιατρός','Retained final acute'])
                record('Uppercase decomposed Greek is recognised',lookup(unicodedata.normalize('NFD','ὈΝΟΜΆΚΛΥΤΟΣ')),['ὀνομάκλυτος','Raised to the antepenult'])
                frame.locator('[data-word="περικλυτός"]').click()
                record('Example button displays contrasting partner',[frame.locator('#form').inner_text(),frame.locator('#partner').inner_text()],['περικλυτός','πρόκλυτος'])
                lookup('αδοκιμον')
                record('Unknown clears stale analysis without inventing accent',[frame.locator('#status').inner_text(),frame.locator('#form').inner_text(),frame.locator('#partner').inner_text(),frame.locator('#contrast').is_visible()],['Not in this explorer’s listed examples. No accent has been generated.','','',False])
                lookup('   ')
                record('Whitespace returns empty prompt',frame.locator('#status').inner_text(),'Choose an example or type a listed form.')
                lookup('ιππιατρος')
                frame.locator('#reset').click()
                record('Reset clears fields and returns focus',[frame.locator('#word').input_value(),frame.locator('#form').inner_text(),frame.locator('#word').evaluate('(el)=>el===document.activeElement')],['','',True])
            else:
                record('Empty initial analysis',frame.locator('#outTokens').inner_text(),'—')
                for word, expected in [('μάσσω','μάγειρος'),('πέπτω','πέπειρος'),('ὀνῶ','ὄνειρος'),(unicodedata.normalize('NFD','ἀΐσσω'),'αἴγειρος')]:
                    frame.locator('#verb').fill(word)
                    frame.locator('#btnMake').click()
                    record('Passage verbal example '+word,frame.locator('#outMake b').inner_text(),expected)
                frame.locator('#verb').fill('γραφω')
                frame.locator('#btnMake').click()
                record('Unsupported verb produces no guessed word',frame.locator('#outMake').inner_text(),'Not one of the four verbal examples in this passage; no form generated.\nResult: —')
                unknown_results = []
                for word in ('constructor','__proto__'):
                    frame.locator('#verb').fill(word)
                    frame.locator('#btnMake').click()
                    unknown_results.append(frame.locator('#outMake').inner_text())
                record('Object property names remain unsupported input',unknown_results,['Not one of the four verbal examples in this passage; no form generated.\nResult: —']*2)
                frame.locator('#inp').fill('Καβείρους')
                frame.locator('#btnToI').click()
                record('Accented ει converts to ι',frame.locator('#inp').input_value(),'Καβίρους')
                frame.locator('#inp').fill('Κάμειρος')
                frame.locator('#btnToEi').click()
                frame.locator('#btnToEi').click()
                record('Existing ει is unchanged on repeated preference',frame.locator('#inp').input_value(),'Κάμειρος')
                frame.locator('#inp').fill(unicodedata.normalize('NFD','Κάμιρος'))
                frame.locator('#btnToEi').click()
                record('Decomposed ι form converts without losing accent',frame.locator('#inp').input_value(),'Κάμειρος')
                frame.locator('#inp').fill('Καμείρος')
                frame.locator('#btnAnalyze').click()
                record('Accent lookup avoids a second acute',frame.locator('#outAccent b').inner_text(),'Κάμειρος')
                frame.locator('#inp').fill('ἤπειρος')
                frame.locator('#btnAnalyze').click()
                record('Cited breathing and accent are preserved',frame.locator('#outAccent b').inner_text(),'ἤπειρος')
                frame.locator('#inp').fill('Καβείρους')
                frame.locator('#btnAnalyze').click()
                record('Accented diphthong highlight is a single category',[frame.locator('#outToggle .ei').inner_text(),frame.locator('#outToggle .ei .i').count()],['εί',0])
                frame.locator('#inp').fill('ἀδοκιμος')
                record('Unknown accent is not generated',frame.locator('#outAccent').inner_text(),'Not a listed accent example; no accent prediction is supplied.')
                frame.locator('#verb').fill('')
                frame.locator('#btnClear').click()
                record('Empty verb and Clear reset outputs',[frame.locator('#inp').input_value(),frame.locator('#outTokens').inner_text(),frame.locator('#outAccent').inner_text(),frame.locator('#outMake b').inner_text()],['','—','—','—'])
            # Exercise layouts with visible Greek analysis, not just empty state.
            if role == 'new':
                lookup('δουρι κλυτος')
            else:
                frame.locator('#inp').fill('Καβείρους Κάμειρος')
                frame.locator('#verb').fill('ἀΐσσω')
                frame.locator('#btnAnalyze').click()
            record('Desktop layout has no horizontal overflow',no_overflow(frame),True)
            page.set_viewport_size({'width':320,'height':900})
            record('Narrow 320px layout has no horizontal overflow',no_overflow(frame),True)
            record('No gadget JavaScript errors',len(errors),0)
            record('No candidate external requests',len(attempted),0)
            observed = confinement(page,attempted)
            record('Separate production-renderer CSP resource, connection and form probes',observed,dict(image_blocked=True,script_blocked=True,connection_blocked=True,form_blocked=True,external_requests=0,sandbox='allow-scripts allow-forms'))
            summary = f'{len(assertions)} browser assertions passed, including passage examples, empty/reset, desktop/320px layout, no JavaScript errors or external requests, and separate runtime CSP resource/connection/form confinement.'
            results[role] = {
                'candidate_sha256':digest(candidate),
                'browser':'Chromium '+browser.version,
                'interaction':'Real text entry and button clicks inside the production gadget_srcdoc and allow-scripts allow-forms iframe; every external request intercepted and aborted.',
                'expected':summary,
                'actual':summary,
                'assertions':assertions,
                'harness':Path(__file__).read_text()
            }
            context.close()
        browser.close()
    return results


if __name__ == '__main__':
    bundle = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
    results = run(bundle)
    Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({role:dict(candidate_sha256=evidence['candidate_sha256'],passing_assertions=len(evidence['assertions'])) for role,evidence in results.items()},ensure_ascii=False))

ει ↔ ι “spelling toggle”

Herodian discusses -ρος words of more than two syllables with a long penult, written ει or long ι. βαρυτόνα means the accent is not on the last syllable; it does not require a written grave. This lookup restores only listed passage examples. Iota length cannot be inferred from spelling alone.

2) Explore the four verbal examples

Herodian notes a pattern like μάσσω → μάγειρος, ὀνῶ → ὄνειρος, πέπτω → πέπειρος. This lookup follows Herodian’s four stated derivations; it does not derive new words.

Output

Try: μασσω ονω πεπτω αϊσσω

Mini-legend

  • ει in the penult is highlighted as “long-ish” for this toy.
  • ι can also count as long in Herodian’s discussion (e.g. Κάμιρος).
  • Accent forms are looked up from the passage; unknown words receive no accent prediction.
What is this based on?
Passage (Herodian, Περὶ καθολικῆς προσῳδίας 1.198): nouns in -ρος with a long penult written ει (or long ι) and with a “longer” shape are treated as βαρυτόνα; he discusses spellings like Κάμειρος vs Κάμιρος, and “verbal” nouns like μάγειρος, ὄνειρος, πέπειρος, αἴγειρος.

original.english_translation: Nouns in -ρος, when their penult is more than two syllables from the end and is lengthened with the diphthong ει or with ι alone lengthened, are accented with a grave: Κάμειρος, the proper name—he is the son of Cercaphus the son of Helius and of Cydippe—with a diphthong; but Κάμιρος, a city in Rhodes, with ι: “Λίνδον Ἰήλυσόν τε καὶ ἠνεμόεντα Κάμιρον” (Il. Β 656). ἤπειρος; Κάβειρος, a city of Lower Asia. But Alexion writes the daimones Καβείρους with ι, and likewise Philoxenus. Tradition, however, has the diphthong, and perhaps it ran together with μάγειρος, αἴγειρος, πέπειρος, ὄνειρος. Ἄνδειρος is the name of a river; Κόνειρος, the name of a people; ὄνειρος, πέπειρος, μάγειρος from μάσσω, “the one who kneads the barley-cakes.” The Aeolians, however, write with ι. αἴγειρος is written with the diphthong in both syllables; for it is found also without ι, as in “καὶ αἰγέρων ἔφυσαν εὐγενέστεραι,” and with pleonasm of ι, αἴγειρος in Homer (Od. η 106): “μακεδνῆς αἰγείροιο.” For verbal nouns in -ρος want their penult to be with the diphthong ει, e.g. ἀΐσσω → αἴγειρος, μάσσω → μάγειρος, ὀνῶ → ὄνειρος, πέπτω → πέπειρος. But the αι of the first syllable has come from ἀΐσσω by crasis. There is also Αἴγειρος, a city of the Megarid, as Theopompus says in the fifty-sixth book, which Strabo calls Αἰγείρουσα. σάπφειρος, a stone; Στάγειρος. Κάσπειρος, a city of the Parthians near India, and the ethnic name likewise. Στάλιρος, Σίτιρος, Βίστιρος, a city of Thrace, and Πίστιρος, the trading-post. Κύστιρος, Δύσιρος, Βεδύσιρος; ἄϊρος, a compound from the disyllable Ἶρος: “ἦ τάχα Ἶρος ἄϊρος”

            def abort(route):
                attempted.append('blocked request')
                route.abort()
            context.route('**/*',abort)
            page = context.new_page()
            page.on('pageerror',lambda error: errors.append(str(error)))
            frame = mount(page,candidate)
            def record(case, actual, expected):
                actual, expected = encode(actual), encode(expected)
                entry = dict(case=case,expected=expected,actual=actual,passed=actual==expected)
                assertions.append(entry)
                assert entry['passed'], json.dumps(entry,ensure_ascii=False)
            if role == 'new':
                def lookup(word):
                    frame.locator('#word').fill(word)
                    frame.locator('#inspect').click()
                    return [frame.locator('#form').inner_text(),frame.locator('#kind').inner_text()]
                record('Empty initial prompt',frame.locator('#status').inner_text(),'Choose an example or type a listed form.')
                record('Polysyllabic indeclinable retains acute',lookup('περικλυτος'),['περικλυτός','Retained final acute'])
                record('Monosyllabic indeclinable raises accent',lookup('προκλυτος'),['πρόκλυτος','Raised to the antepenult'])
                lookup('ναυσικλυτος')
                record('Dative compound exception is explicit',[frame.locator('#form').inner_text(),frame.locator('#kind').inner_text(),'dative ναυσί' in frame.locator('#reason').inner_text()],['ναυσικλυτός','Marked exception: final acute',True])
                record('Juxtaposed phrase stays two words',lookup('  δουρι   κλυτος  '),['δουρὶ κλυτός','Juxtaposition: two words'])
                record('φιλίατρος raises accent',lookup('φιλιατρος'),['φιλίατρος','Raised accent'])
                record('ἀρχιατρός preserves final acute',lookup('αρχιατρος'),['ἀρχιατρός','Retained final acute'])
                record('Uppercase decomposed Greek is recognised',lookup(unicodedata.normalize('NFD','ὈΝΟΜΆΚΛΥΤΟΣ')),['ὀνομάκλυτος','Raised to the antepenult'])
                frame.locator('[data-word="περικλυτός"]').click()
                record('Example button displays contrasting partner',[frame.locator('#form').inner_text(),frame.locator('#partner').inner_text()],['περικλυτός','πρόκλυτος'])
                lookup('αδοκιμον')
                record('Unknown clears stale analysis without inventing accent',[frame.locator('#status').inner_text(),frame.locator('#form').inner_text(),frame.locator('#partner').inner_text(),frame.locator('#contrast').is_visible()],['Not in this explorer’s listed examples. No accent has been generated.','','',False])
                lookup('   ')
                record('Whitespace returns empty prompt',frame.locator('#status').inner_text(),'Choose an example or type a listed form.')
                lookup('ιππιατρος')
                frame.locator('#reset').click()
                record('Reset clears fields and returns focus',[frame.locator('#word').input_value(),frame.locator('#form').inner_text(),frame.locator('#word').evaluate('(el)=>el===document.activeElement')],['','',True])
            else:
                record('Empty initial analysis',frame.locator('#outTokens').inner_text(),'—')
                for word, expected in [('μάσσω','μάγειρος'),('πέπτω','πέπειρος'),('ὀνῶ','ὄνειρος'),(unicodedata.normalize('NFD','ἀΐσσω'),'αἴγειρος')]:
                    frame.locator('#verb').fill(word)
                    frame.locator('#btnMake').click()
                    record('Passage verbal example '+word,frame.locator('#outMake b').inner_text(),expected)
                frame.locator('#verb').fill('γραφω')
                frame.locator('#btnMake').click()
                record('Unsupported verb produces no guessed word',frame.locator('#outMake').inner_text(),'Not one of the four verbal examples in this passage; no form generated.\nResult: —')
                unknown_results = []
                for word in ('constructor','__proto__'):
                    frame.locator('#verb').fill(word)
                    frame.locator('#btnMake').click()
                    unknown_results.append(frame.locator('#outMake').inner_text())
                record('Object property names remain unsupported input',unknown_results,['Not one of the four verbal examples in this passage; no form generated.\nResult: —']*2)
                frame.locator('#inp').fill('Καβείρους')
                frame.locator('#btnToI').click()
                record('Accented ει converts to ι',frame.locator('#inp').input_value(),'Καβίρους')
                frame.locator('#inp').fill('Κάμειρος')
                frame.locator('#btnToEi').click()
                frame.locator('#btnToEi').click()
                record('Existing ει is unchanged on repeated preference',frame.locator('#inp').input_value(),'Κάμειρος')
                frame.locator('#inp').fill(unicodedata.normalize('NFD','Κάμιρος'))
                frame.locator('#btnToEi').click()
                record('Decomposed ι form converts without losing accent',frame.locator('#inp').input_value(),'Κάμειρος')
                frame.locator('#inp').fill('Καμείρος')
                frame.locator('#btnAnalyze').click()
                record('Accent lookup avoids a second acute',frame.locator('#outAccent b').inner_text(),'Κάμειρος')
                frame.locator('#inp').fill('ἤπειρος')
                frame.locator('#btnAnalyze').click()
                record('Cited breathing and accent are preserved',frame.locator('#outAccent b').inner_text(),'ἤπειρος')
                frame.locator('#inp').fill('Καβείρους')
                frame.locator('#btnAnalyze').click()
                record('Accented diphthong highlight is a single category',[frame.locator('#outToggle .ei').inner_text(),frame.locator('#outToggle .ei .i').count()],['εί',0])
                frame.locator('#inp').fill('ἀδοκιμος')
                record('Unknown accent is not generated',frame.locator('#outAccent').inner_text(),'Not a listed accent example; no accent prediction is supplied.')
                frame.locator('#verb').fill('')
                frame.locator('#btnClear').click()
                record('Empty verb and Clear reset outputs',[frame.locator('#inp').input_value(),frame.locator('#outTokens').inner_text(),frame.locator('#outAccent').inner_text(),frame.locator('#outMake b').inner_text()],['','—','—','—'])
            # Exercise layouts with visible Greek analysis, not just empty state.
            if role == 'new':
                lookup('δουρι κλυτος')
            else:
                frame.locator('#inp').fill('Καβείρους Κάμειρος')
                frame.locator('#verb').fill('ἀΐσσω')
                frame.locator('#btnAnalyze').click()
            record('Desktop layout has no horizontal overflow',no_overflow(frame),True)
            page.set_viewport_size({'width':320,'height':900})
            record('Narrow 320px layout has no horizontal overflow',no_overflow(frame),True)
            record('No gadget JavaScript errors',len(errors),0)
            record('No candidate external requests',len(attempted),0)
            observed = confinement(page,attempted)
            record('Separate production-renderer CSP resource, connection and form probes',observed,dict(image_blocked=True,script_blocked=True,connection_blocked=True,form_blocked=True,external_requests=0,sandbox='allow-scripts allow-forms'))
            summary = f'{len(assertions)} browser assertions passed, including passage examples, empty/reset, desktop/320px layout, no JavaScript errors or external requests, and separate runtime CSP resource/connection/form confinement.'
            results[role] = {
                'candidate_sha256':digest(candidate),
                'browser':'Chromium '+browser.version,
                'interaction':'Real text entry and button clicks inside the production gadget_srcdoc and allow-scripts allow-forms iframe; every external request intercepted and aborted.',
                'expected':summary,
                'actual':summary,
                'assertions':assertions,
                'harness':Path(__file__).read_text()
            }
            context.close()
        browser.close()
    return results


if __name__ == '__main__':
    bundle = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
    results = run(bundle)
    Path(sys.argv[2]).write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps({role:dict(candidate_sha256=evidence['candidate_sha256'],passing_assertions=len(evidence['assertions'])) for role,evidence in results.items()},ensure_ascii=False))
